instruction:
Consolidated Types IFC CSV Schedule

Start from the provided IFC model at /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and reference image at /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png. Consolidate duplicate element types and material assignments so each repeated construction or product family uses one shared IFC type, save the completed model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc, and use Bonsai/IfcCSV-style IFC data export to save the type and material occurrence schedule as /home/user/Desktop/result.csv.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv with those exact relative paths.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc is an IFC4 file with exactly one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, and one IfcBuildingStorey.
3. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc contains exactly four IfcWall objects, one IfcWallType named WallType_External, and one IfcRelDefinesByType assignment from WallType_External to all four IfcWall occurrences; that type has one material layer set summarized as Brick:0.100m | Insulation:0.050m | Gypsum:0.015m.
4. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc contains exactly one IfcSlab object, one IfcSlabType named SlabType_200, and one IfcRelDefinesByType assignment from SlabType_200 to the IfcSlab occurrence; that type has one material layer set summarized as Concrete:0.200m.
5. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc contains exactly two IfcDoor objects, one IfcDoorType named Door Type A, and one IfcRelDefinesByType assignment from Door Type A to both IfcDoor occurrences; that type has material Timber.
6. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc contains exactly four IfcWindow objects, one IfcWindowType named Window Type W, and one IfcRelDefinesByType assignment from Window Type W to all four IfcWindow occurrences; that type has material Aluminum.
7. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc contains exactly six IfcMaterial objects named Brick, Insulation, Gypsum, Concrete, Timber, and Aluminum after case-insensitive normalization, and contains no IfcBuildingElementProxy objects and no IfcFurniture objects.
8. /home/user/Desktop/result.csv contains headers Class, TypeName, MaterialSummary, and OccurrenceCount, matched case-insensitively while ignoring spaces, hyphens, and underscores.
9. /home/user/Desktop/result.csv contains exactly four data rows with these values: IfcWall, WallType_External, Brick:0.100m | Insulation:0.050m | Gypsum:0.015m, 4; IfcSlab, SlabType_200, Concrete:0.200m, 1; IfcDoor, Door Type A, Timber, 2; IfcWindow, Window Type W, Aluminum, 4.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
